lede.defaultMessage: Pick a route, a night and a fare. Prices are per traveller and include the reservation.
lede.description: The paragraph under the planner's heading.

route.description: Label of the route picker in the planner.

date.description: Label of the date picker in the planner.

travellers.description: Label of the number of travellers in the planner.

fare.description: Label of the fare choice in the planner.

summary.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {One traveller} other {# travellers}} in {fare, select, seat {a reclining seat} couchette {a couchette} cabin {a private cabin} other {any fare}}, leaving {origin} on {at, date, departure}.
summary.description: The sentence summing up the planner's choices; the origin is a city already translated, the date is in the `departure` named format.

line.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# traveller} other {# travellers}} × {amount, number, price}
line.description: The price line of the planner: the travellers times the fare each pays.

held.defaultMessage: Held for {count, plural, one {# traveller} other {# travellers}} until {until, time, short}. Nothing is charged yet.
held.description: Confirmation after the button is pressed; the time is in the visitor's time zone.
